user.title: Battery ROI
user.description: Pick the sensors from your own setup. Only battery power and price are required.

data.price_surcharge: Extra cost per kWh on top of that price

data_description.charge_power: Power flowing into the battery (W or kW). If you only have one signed power sensor, pick it here and leave discharge power empty.
data_description.discharge_power: Power flowing out of the battery. Leave empty when the sensor above is signed.
data_description.positive_means: Only used with a single signed power sensor.
data_description.price: Your dynamic tariff sensor, for example EPEX, Nordpool, ENTSO-e, Tibber, Frank Energie or Zonneplan. EUR/kWh, ct/kWh and per-MWh units are converted automatically.
data_description.price_surcharge: Optional. Use this when your price sensor is the raw market price (EPEX): add energy tax, supplier fee and VAT here, in EUR/kWh. Leave empty for Tibber and other all-in prices.
data_description.feed_in_price: Optional. What you get for exporting a kWh. Only used together with the grid power sensor; without both, the import price is used for both directions.
data_description.grid_power: Optional. HomeWizard P1 or another meter: positive when importing, negative when exporting. Needed to tell whether the battery avoided buying or selling.
data_description.standby_power: Optional. What the battery uses itself (inverter, BMS) that its power sensors don't show, in W. Counted as a cost. Leave empty if your charge sensor already includes it.
data_description.wear_cost: Optional. Battery degradation in EUR per kWh delivered, for example purchase cost ÷ (capacity × rated cycles). Counted once per kWh, on discharge.

error.same_sensor: Charge and discharge power must be different sensors.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Battery ROI is already set up. Use Configure to change sensors.
